basic_profile.bio: Based in Lisbon, Portugal, I'm a software engineer with a passion for gaming and technology. I spend most of my evenings exploring the latest tech trends and engaging in discussions about video games, especially the PS5. When I'm not online, I enjoy attending local football matches and exploring new cafes. I'm in a committed relationship and often share my gaming experiences with my partner. My typical online hours are in the evenings, between 7 PM and midnight, local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of Lisbon and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My knowledge spans software development, gaming technology, and consumer electronics. I have always been a self-learner, constantly updating my skills through online courses and tech forums.
